prompts.animals-farm:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final 16:9 wide environment background for a children's story game, approximately 1672 by 941 pixels. Reference image is art craft only: original cinematic animated-feature world, tactile sculpted surfaces, warm soft golden lighting, cream and forest-green detailing, appealing high-resolution environment with believable depth. No characters, no UI, no labels or text. Keep a broad uncluttered middle playfield for draggable game objects; rich environmental storytelling at sides, foreground corners and far background. Eye-level slightly elevated game camera, no extreme perspective. Do not reproduce the mixed habitats in the reference.
A welcoming farm morning: a sunlit meadow courtyard, charming rounded timber barn on far left, hay loft, wool baskets, little empty nesting shelter, fenced orchard at edges, a gentle curving dirt path through a broad clear central grassy playfield. Invitation bunting in cream/ochre at the top corners, soft distant rolling hills. Premium animated-film set, not a flat backdrop. No people or animals.
